source: https://csrc.nist.gov/projects/cybersecurity-framework (NIST CSF 2.0 Core; machine-readable via the NIST Cybersecurity and Privacy Reference Tool, CPRT)
note: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 Core, U.S. government work in the public domain. This checked-in file is the complete set of the 22 CSF 2.0 Categories (the control-domain granularity the reporting phase maps findings to), so the skill and tests run offline. It does NOT include the finer Subcategories (e.g. PR.AA-01); regenerate the full Category + Subcategory catalog with sync_csf.py, then commit. Ids are the CSF element identifiers (Category XX.YY, Subcategory XX.YY-NN); names are the official Category titles.

catalog.PR.AA: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
